portal_description:
The ipxe packages provide iPXE, an open source network bootloader, which offers a direct replacement for proprietary Pre-Boot Execution Environment (PXE) ROMs and includes many extra features, such as DNS, HTTP, or iSCSI.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.3 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of ipxe are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
